title: Eight Sleep's new Pod 6 comes in smaller and solo sizes, starting at $1,999 | TechCrunch
summary: Sleep tech company Eight Sleep on Wednesday launched its new Pod 6 device in a smaller size than previous editions to fit more bed frames, along with solo sizes for one-person use.
